messages:
Amanda: Heads-up — pen-test intake submitted for Acme (intake ID PT-4821). Need to align on log collection, evidence artifacts, RBAC for assessors, and KMS handling.
security-bot: New pen-test intake received: acme-2026-03-18. Intake ID: PT-4821. Assigned to eng-security.
Jon: For assessors we should use an ephemeral SSO role (pt-assessor) with a 4h session. No permanent policy changes.
Amanda: +1. Can we get the exact role JSON and a short runbook for creating it? Need that in the evidence pack.
Michael: Log exports: we can run `rcli logs export --range 2026-03-10..2026-03-17 --output s3://acme-pt-exports` but we should provide a presigned upload path for assessors to drop evidence back.
Jon: Presigned URLs + a temp bucket is simplest. Create the bucket with restricted ACL and object lock disabled, lifecycle 90d. Will generate presigned PUTs per file.
Pauline: For scheduling, ask the vendor for a preferred 2-week window. We prefer week of 2026-04-12 for the retest. Also need an initial severity triage within 48h of report receipt.
Amanda: Action owners: Jon -> ephemeral role + bucket + presigned flow; Michael -> log export commands + sample manifest + minimal query snapshots; Pauline -> confirm retest window with assessor; Nina -> KMS policy + envelope key.
Jon: Sample IAM fragment to include in runbook:
```
{
  "RoleName": "pt-assessor",
  "AssumeRolePolicyDocument": {"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/okta-pt"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]},
  "InlinePolicies": [{"PolicyName":"pt-assess","PolicyDocument":{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:DescribeLogGroups","logs:StartQuery","logs:GetQueryResults","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"*"}]}}],
  "MaxSessionDuration": 14400
}
```
Make sure we log session IDs and rotate creds after window.
Michael: KMS note — assessors should not have raw key decrypt. We'll use an envelope key pattern: service performs decrypt under a restricted proxy; assessors get only wrapped artifacts. I'll open a KMS request.
security-bot: KMS request ticket created: KMS-7721. Assigned to @Nina.
Nina: I can provision an envelope key with decrypt disabled for outside roles and provide the key ARN + policy snapshot. Will post by EOD.
Amanda: Draft evidence checklist (please comment/add):
- logs export manifest (sha256 hashes)
- presigned upload confirmation + bucket name
- assessor session IDs + start/end times
- KMS envelope key ARN + policy snapshot
- sample event IDs and query snapshots for verification
- replay instructions / trace IDs for app-level findings

Pauline: Add: sampling plan for huge datasets (e.g., 1% traffic sample + 24h full-day sample for repro). Also include instructions for assembling reproducer bundles.
Michael: To reduce size: provide query snapshots, a 24h full export for the critical window, and tailing link (live stream) for interactive verification. That should satisfy the vendor without full dump.
Amanda: I'll draft the intake response to the assessor with this checklist + timeline and send for review. Please ACK so I can mark owners.
Jon: ack
Michael: ack
Pauline: ack
Nina: ack
Amanda: Thanks — I'll post the formal intake reply and attach runbook + presigned example when ready.
